items.headline: Cisco permitted for $15M second-floor office renovation
items.summary: A $15,000,000 office tenant improvement permit was issued for the second floor at 3098 Olsen Drive for Cisco. No unit count applies since this is a commercial office project.

items.headline: Council reviewed red light camera traffic program
items.summary: The council received a presentation on the city's Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program, covering how the enforcement cameras have been used to address intersection safety.

items.headline: Council briefed on Milpitas Community Center's condition
items.summary: Staff presented an assessment of the physical condition of the Milpitas Community Center, a facility used for city programs and events.

items.headline: 5-unit townhouse building permitted on Seely Avenue
items.summary: A new 5-unit townhouse building, part of the Trimble Summerhill development (Lot 21), was permitted on Seely Av at a cost of $1,841,161. The lot has not yet been assigned a street number.
